summary: BRUNES SERVICE AS (org. no. 998 584 043) is a private limited company (AS) based in Steigen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-07-04. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 43.320 (Snekkerarbeid). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 3.2 m and net income was NOK 50 927. CEO: Ronny Andre Brunes; board chair: Ronny Andre Brunes.
